description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys class, specifically testing Netflix key session management, including creation, selection, and closing of key sessions, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysNetflixKeySessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MediaKeys Netflix key session functionalities.

methods.name: CreateKeySession
methods.description: Tests forwarding of createKeySession request to IPC and handling of key session ID and error status.

methods.name: SelectKeyId
methods.description: Tests adding a KeyId to a session and verifying the mapping.

methods.name: SelectKeyIdFailure
methods.description: Tests failure case when selecting a key ID for a session.

methods.name: CloseKeySession
methods.description: Tests forwarding of closeKeySession request to IPC and session cleanup.
